system.description:
When you Order a follower to Defend and they roll a 7+, they hold Readiness (7–9: hold 1; 10+: hold 3; a shield adds +1). Spend their Readiness to have them suffer the damage/effects of an attack for their ward, or draw all attention to themselves. If they wouldn't want to do what you're spending it on, spend 1 Readiness and 1 Loyalty — there's rarely time to Persuade them mid-fight.

When a follower Aids you to Defend, you hold the Readiness instead; spend it to have the follower suffer the damage/effects of an attack, or draw all attention from your ward to itself.

When a group of followers fights another group, roll a single Clash or Let Fly once for the whole group. Each side has HP and Armor and deals damage as one individual. Lost HP represents casualties proportionate to the group's original HP.

If one side outnumbers the other, that side gets +1 Armor and +1 damage for each multiplier past the first (e.g. 3:1 gives +2 damage and +2 Armor).
